_: Each lord's one want (characters.js ambitionOf; CK3's ambitions, KoDP's lords who each want something): his goal made a thing in the realm, a town to take (land, power), a house to wed into (marriage), a man to settle with (revenge). It drives his court matters: a plea of a kind his want drives (drives) weighs boost times more when he chooses what to bring, and a lord who wants land or power brings his want itself (plea: weight; the town nearest his seat that another great house holds, within reach tiles). lines: how he says it on his sheet ({town}, {house}, {name}). plea: the King's three answers' favour (back: him up, its holder down, and war between them; forbid; promise: him a little, at a cost).

lines.power: {town} first. Then the realm will know my house.
lines.marriage: I mean to see my heir wed into {house}.
lines.revenge: I will settle the old score with {name} of {house}.
lines.crown: I mean to sit the throne myself one day.
lines.peace: I want my people fed and out of other men's wars.
lines.favour: I mean to rise in my liege's esteem.
lines.court: I mean to be noticed by the King himself.
lines.defect: I mean to find a liege more worthy of my sword.

act._: A lord who wants land or power and is not loyal goes to war for his town himself (characters.js press): press is the move's base score; forbidden is added to it, and to a rising's, once the King forbade him that town.

match._: A lord who wants a match asks the King to make it (royalmatch): his eldest unwed child of age to the eldest unwed child of the other sex of the house he likes best; the King's answers' favour.
